notes.title: New update: lights & control setting
notes.notes:
Hello again,

We've got another good announcement for you :)
This time we updated the lights and the control settings.

We decided to change the lights in some of the locations from dynamic to static.
We hope that this will prove to be a better solution and you will enjoy the game more. 

We also fixed a problem with the control settings .
You should now be able to change the controls freely!

Hope you like the update? :)
Inner Voices Team

notes.title: New content update for Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some good news for you! :)

A new content update and patch will be available on Steam Summer Sale!

We addressed most of the issues and fixed most of the bugs reported by the players, related to:
stability, 
visuals,
game mechanics.

We have also added new features for you to enjoy.

From now on you will be able to:
 
- Adjust “jumpscares” in the Options Menu.
You can now turn the jump scares off in the Options Menu at any time during the game. 
Also, all of the available jumpscares occur just once in the gameplay.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/e4b6ed23b359072dda0516428c35cc7b4e28b505.jpg
 
- Enjoy new riddles.
We added new environmental riddles. 
You can explore your surroundings and solve them to complete The Alphabet. 
The tasks are not related to the main story. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/5ea3145134d695380279e61110f36de7bd914ac4.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/b2917777406fdf097bca0587216604597fbb01b2.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018894/a426c48aac87169d79ce55effb225802bf738fc2.jpg

Thanks to your feedback we can keep improving our game!
Thank you and stay tuned!

Inner Voices team.
